data.description: Per-element timezone converter. Renders the source time + the visitor's local equivalent. Detects the visitor's timezone via Intl.DateTimeFormat. Hides the local label automatically when source and visitor zones match.

data-aed-tz.description: Source time. Accepts ISO with offset (e.g. '2026-05-15T14:00-05:00'), ISO local datetime, or 'HH:MM' time-only (interpreted in `tz-from` for today's date).

data-aed-tz-variant.description: Boxed card variant. Default is inline.

data-aed-tz-local-label.description: Label shown next to the visitor's local time.

data-aed-tz-show-date.description: Include the date alongside the time.
